messages:
ella: We started seeing a sharp spike in 5xx (502/504) from hosted inference at ~09:12 UTC. Affected route: POST /v1/generate. Sample request id: rq_0a1b2c3d. Customers reporting timeouts and errors. ticket INC-4582.
ben_sre: Looking at gateway and prefix-proxy logs: lots of memcached timeouts and `ERR` responses. Suspect prefix-layer memcached pool exhaustion.
maria_support: We have at least two enterprise customers hitting retries and complaining about billing/latency. Escalating to SRE oncall. cc @oncall_sre
opsbot: ALERT: KV_PREFIX_POOL_EXHAUSTION memcached-prefix-cluster-7 us-east-1 at 09:13:15 UTC :warning:
kevin_infra: tail from gateway around 09:14:
```
ERROR gateway: upstream memcached timeout: dial tcp 10.23.12.45:11211: i/o timeout
WARN prefixcache: conn hang detected: connID=7fa3, age=45s
```
nish_engineering: We rotated memcached auth tokens at ~09:05 UTC. I'm seeing `NOAUTH Authentication required` in memcached auth logs for several clients — possible race where many proxies reauth at once.
ben_sre: Repro (from a test client in us-east-1):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","prompt":"hello"}'
# -> 504 Gateway Timeout after ~1.2s
```
ella: Can someone run a quick stats dump on memcached server? `echo stats | nc 10.23.12.45 11211`
ben_sre: Memcached stats show current_connections: 2000, total_connections: 12345, connection_structures: 2000. Pool configured at 2000 for prefix-proxy. Looks saturated.
maria_support: Could be a connection leak or sudden reconnect storm from rotation. Customers seeing retries that amplify load.
kevin_infra: Immediate mitigation I started: rolling restart of prefix-proxy pods in us-east-1 to force fresh connections. K8s rollout initiated.
opsbot: deployment-bot: restarted deployment prefix-proxy-us-east-1 (3/3 pods rolled)
ben_sre: After the restart we saw error rate drop but still intermittent 502 when client returns `ERR NOAUTH`.
nish_engineering: Checking auth rotation service logs: token refresh started at 09:05 and returned 429s from IAM at 09:06-09:09 (Too Many Requests). Rotation client didn't back off, so ~50 prefix-proxy instances attempted refresh simultaneously. Stale creds then caused `NOAUTH`.
kevin_infra: Scaling prefix-proxy replicas from 3 -> 6 temporarily to spread reconnects and reduce rotation blast. Also increasing memcached prefix pool headroom (2000 -> 4000) to absorb bursts.
opsbot: note: no rollback of rotation currently; rotation paused per @nish_engineering while we implement backoff.
ben_sre: Sample error snippet from prefix-proxy logs: 
```
[09:14:23] prefix-proxy memclient.go:312: Get(kv:client/pfx/abc): dial tcp 10.23.12.45:11211: i/o timeout
[09:14:25] prefix-proxy memclient.go:318: Received ERR from server: NOAUTH Authentication required
```
maria_support: Sent customer-facing notification: "We're investigating a cache connectivity issue causing elevated 5xx on the hosted API. Engineers are working on mitigation; estimated 30m."
ella: Action items: 
- ben_sre: collect full memcached client logs and wire traces for 09:00-09:30 UTC (include conn counts and stack traces)
- nish_engineering: confirm IAM rate-limit evidence and add exponential backoff + jitter to token rotation; pause rotation rollout for now
- kevin_infra: temporarily increase prefix pool capacity and scale replicas; monitor connection metrics
- maria_support: follow up with impacted customers and prepare credit/comp plan if SLA breached
ben_sre: After changes at 09:30-09:35 UTC, 5xx rate dropped from ~8% to ~0.6% for the host. Still watching for small blips.
nish_engineering: Created PR to add leader-elected stagger to rotations and implement backoff (internal link: PR-xxxx). Also adding alert rule to detect `NOAUTH` in memclient logs.
kevin_infra: Recommend long-term: staggered rotations via leader election, backoff+jitter on creds refresh, add connection pool auto-headroom scaling, and improve upstream IAM throttling visibility.
maria_support: I'll draft a post-incident summary and customer outreach notes. Also tracking billing impact for affected customers.
ella: Thanks everyone. Leaving thread open for 24h to monitor. Logging follow-ups in INC-4582. :thumbsup:
